Sing a song of praise together

Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Love)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
Since the creation of the world, God saw man’s need for a woman. The world teaches us many wrong things about marriage. Today, we will look at what God requires of husbands and wives.
Colossians 3:18-19
1 Peter 3:1-2
Ephesians 5:22-33 (Husbands and Wives)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
When a man and a woman are married, they become one.
Wives should submit to their husbands.
Husbands do not be harsh with your wives.
A husband should love his wife like Jesus loves the Church and gave Himself up for her.
Wives should be respectful to their husbands even if their husband is not obedient to Jesus. Through this they may be won to Christ.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Honor God with your marriage.
Husbands: Do something for your wife to show her how much you love her. Remember as a husband, Jesus calls you to love her like He loves the Church.
Wives: Do something for your husband to show him that you love and respect Him.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
Many people have never heard the Gospel and will never hear unless someone goes to them and tells them. Let’s commit to share the Gospel with them.
Romans 10:14-15
Pray
Those who are married should pray for their husband or wife. If your husband or wife does not follow Jesus, pray that they would come to know Him.
